decisions.text: behaviour: a matched product with no amount is an `unmatched` entry carrying `productId` and `missing: ['amount', …]`; the draft asks «כמה?» and then fills the row — reverse: send it back to the product question
behaviour: the amount question uses the shared `app-counter`, because a typed number input was flagged as a copy by the reuse check — reverse: swap for a plain number field
behaviour: `missing` is optional in the shared types, and the screen derives it from what is absent when the server did not send it — reverse: make it required
behaviour: the base-amount popover closes on any outside click, on Escape and on its close button — reverse: drop the `host` listeners in stock-count.component.ts

behaviour: built-in spoken words with no unit of the app behind them (ארגז, קרטון, שק, חבילה, מגש) stay as said, never mapped to a key; the product decides whether it has them — reverse: map them to a unit key in BUILTIN_NAMES
behaviour: a line that duplicates a product already counted in another unit goes to `unmatched` with missing ['product'], as before — reverse: give it its own `missing` value
